verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe returned HTTP 200 for https://www.tax.ny.gov/robots.txt with real directives: guidance pages are open to all agents, and the /e-services/ Online Services transaction paths are disallowed for all user agents. An agent can therefore learn what it may read before fetching anything. The probe also respected the disallow and never fetched an /e-services/ path. Missing for 10: corroboration beyond a single dated probe, and evidence of agent- or AI-specific user-agent directives or a documented crawl policy.
